page_title: MAL 1-1 VAL | Mallorca v Valencia 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Francisco Maeso is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Ruben Baraja is forced to make a change. Thierry Correia is unable to continue due to injury, Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) comes on.
90+4' Thierry Correia (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

90+2' Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' The game is interrupted. Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Mallorca, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
88' Selim Amallah (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Francisco Maeso stops the game and makes a call. Mallorca get a free kick.
86' Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
86' Mallorca work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

85' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Mallorca are going to take it.
84' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

83' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Mallorca.
82' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
80' Selim Amallah (Valencia) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
79' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
79' Valencia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
79' This shall not pass! Selim Amallah (Valencia) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Valencia have a corner.
78' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pepelu (Valencia) takes it short.
78' Javi Guerra (Valencia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Valencia win a corner.
77' He should have scored! Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
75' CHANCE! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Giorgi Mamardashvili, who reacts superbly to stop him.
74' Here comes a substitution. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Sergi Darder.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samu Costa leaves the pitch and Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) comes on.
74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
72' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Diego Lopez is replaced by Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
72' Here's the change. Cenk Ozkacar leaves the pitch and Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.
72' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
71' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.
70' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Toni Lato will be replaced by Jaume Costa (Mallorca).
70' Substitution. Antonio Sanchez did his best and is replaced by Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca).
69' Fran Perez (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
67' The attendance for today's match is 17659.
66' Mallorca couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
66' Fran Perez (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Mallorca have been awarded a free kick.
65' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

64' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Giorgi Mamardashvili stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
64' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Cyle Larin (Mallorca) coming on for Abdon Prats.
60' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
58' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Fran Perez (Valencia) replaces Roman Yaremchuk.
56' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

55' What a save from Giorgi Mamardashvili! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.
55' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
54' The game is interrupted now, Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Diego Lopez (Valencia) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' The game is interrupted as Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is flagged offside.
49' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Thierry Correia clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Diego Lopez (Valencia), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Predrag Rajkovic had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
45+3' Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' Hugo Duro (Valencia) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Predrag Rajkovic was alert and the score remained the same.
43' Selim Amallah (Valencia) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca have a free kick.
43' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Diego Lopez, but Predrag Rajkovic displays great awareness to stop him.
41' Javi Guerra (Valencia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Predrag Rajkovic, who smothers the ball.
40' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Mallorca in a dangerous position.
39' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 8:2.
37' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
36' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Samu Costa (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
35' Thierry Correia (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
33' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
31' Francisco Maeso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Toni Lato (Mallorca). A free kick is awarded to Valencia.
30' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

29' Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Valencia win a corner kick.
29' Pepelu (Valencia) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

29' Predrag Rajkovic leaps like a salmon to deny Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Samu Costa (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francisco Maeso saw the whole situation. Valencia earn a free kick.
27' Javi Guerra (Valencia) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
24' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
21' Hugo Duro (Valencia) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
19' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
18' Hugo Duro (Valencia) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. That's a free kick to Mallorca.
17' Pepelu (Valencia) takes a mid-range free kick and his beautiful strike only rattles the right post.
16' It seemed like Pepelu (Valencia) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
16' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
14' Valencia take a short corner kick.
14' Hugo Duro (Valencia) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success. Valencia will take a corner kick.
13' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
11' A cross by Thierry Correia (Valencia) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
9' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca). Valencia will take a free kick near the side line.
5' 1 - 0 It's 1:0! Vedat Muriqi feeds Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the right side of the net.
3' Selim Amallah (Valencia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Mallorca are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Valencia will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Francisco Maeso.
